articles.title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 Narrows Release Window Following Player Feedback
articles.title_tr: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 Narrows Release Window Following Player Feedback
articles.summary: Bandai Namco announced a narrower release window for the upcoming multiplayer-enabled brawler Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3, although it's not too much more specific. Previously, the publisher had stated that the sequel to 2016 fan-favorite would arrive in 2027. Now, it's turned that from a 12-month window into a six-month one, saying that it'll be out in the second half of 2027.
